name: Growth curve close-up
what: A dark card with a glowing top edge and two dashed axes, seen in a close-up while a growth curve is drawn from the origin and the camera glides along it; a hard cut pulls out to the whole tilted card, the curve finishes and a caption fades in underneath. The curve points and the caption are yours.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4-f48 close-up: the curve is drawn from the origin (slow start, then steady) while the camera glides right along it and pulls back a little; f49 hard cut to the whole card (tilted a few degrees), the curve already 56 % drawn; f49-f58 the caption fades in; f49-f88 the curve finishes (a long soft end); f49-f100 the card drifts slowly (shrinks and turns a little); then everything holds to f149; a light runs round the card edge the whole time

tracks.name: curve close-up
tracks.what: the curve is drawn from the origin while the camera glides right along it and pulls back about 10 %

tracks.name: cut out
tracks.what: a hard cut from the close-up to the whole card

tracks.name: caption
tracks.what: the caption fades in under the card

tracks.name: curve finish
tracks.what: the curve is drawn to its end
tracks.easing: steady, then a long soft end (measured)

tracks.name: card drift
tracks.what: the whole card shrinks and turns a little (about 5 % and 2 degrees)

tracks.name: edge light
tracks.what: a light runs round the card edge: a sharp front and a soft tail, one lap in about 135 frames

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything still (the edge light and the film grain move)
